subject: Shipment audit
body: Audit the two enclosed files: use the SI as the reference and identify incorrect details in the draft BL.

subject: Before carrier approval
body: Are the shipping instruction and bill of lading aligned? Please compare them and flag every discrepancy.

subject: Return checked documents
body: Please return your verification of the SI versus draft BL, noting any differing shipment values.

subject: New booking paperwork
body: Compose a shipping instruction for the cargo that we just booked. The carrier is waiting for the SI.

subject: Request for shipping instructions
body: Please produce and send the SI using the customer details below so the line can issue its first BL.

subject: Documentation cutoff tomorrow
body: We require a newly prepared shipping instruction for this order before the documentation cutoff.

subject: Unexpected surcharge
body: Why does our invoice include a fuel surcharge? Please explain the additional amount charged.

subject: Accounts needs clarification
body: The freight invoice total does not match our calculation. Could billing confirm the correct amount?

subject: Settlement query
body: Please advise whether last week's transfer settled the invoice or whether any balance remains payable.

subject: Terminal operating hours
